works.body:
Hello! I love your cowboy artwork and would like to commission you! Please draw my friend and I riding a horse while dressed as cowboys. 

I would like to be sitting behind him, with a panicked expression. I would like for him to be excited and having fun. Here is a reference image of the cowboy pose: https://64.media.tumblr.com/e22273b3c83a83baca7f648d3fe3d2d7/tumblr_o9z1tx14R61sb6epfo2_640.gifv

I will leave the background and outfits up to you! But, please add some cute pink detailing to my outfit (pink hair). 

Here is a reference image of my friend's Vtuber. My Vtuber is the pink haired anime girl. https://twitter.com/cchocolace/status/1526270057004687361

Thank you for your consideration!

https://twitter.com/itsvareena/status/1492161102536331267

I have a vtuber with an explosively fun personality called FroggyLoch. 
I love her artwork and streams, and the game she's been distributing recently is Red Dead Redemption 2. 
I would love see her in your artwork style dressed as a cowboy atop a horse firing a pop-gun or prop of some sort with her big lilypad hat. Her bright and sunny personality as well as her design meshes well with your work.

Her reference material: https://twitter.com/FroggyLoch/status/1463242335819603973
